about: Unity's 2D physics components that are Box2D's one to one, which tide unity translates (notes/unity.md, Packages' translations of Unity's components)
sourceAbout: Added to a Unity project's game: a body starts where its entity's Transform (Unity's placement) is in x and y, turned about z, and the Transform follows the body
source: // A body whose entity has Tide's Transform (in Unity, every one): it starts where the Transform places it in x and y,
// turned as it's turned about z, whatever its position and angle said, and the Transform follows it after each step,
// its z kept, so Unity shows the body where it is. A body's place is the world's: one under an entity that turns
system StartAtTransform(mut Body body, Transform transform)
var sign = q.w < 0 ? -1.0 : 1.0; // The same turn, the short way: an angle from -pi to pi
system FollowTransform(Body body, mut Transform transform)

notUnder: a collider under a Rigidbody2D is a shape of that body, which is Box2D.Part, not one to one
